latestAction.text: Resolution agreed to in Senate without amendment and with a preamble by Unanimous Consent. (consideration: CR S7787)

summary.text: This resolution expresses support for the designation of the week of October 24-October 31, 2025, as Bat Week and acknowledges the important role bats play as pollinators and pest control for agriculture.

title: A resolution expressing support for the designation of the week of October 24, 2025, to October 31, 2025, as "Bat Week".
